chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 440: The Shaoyin Clan’s Endgame & Mu Northson’s Grief
chapter_meta_description: Four Celestial Immortals corner Ji Ning, but the cavalry arrives. As a battle of power turns into a stalemate of conditions, the true cost of the Shaoyin blood-feud is revealed in Mu Northson's shattered heart.
og_title: The Cavalry Arrives, But the Blood-Debt Grows Deeper
og_description: Ji Ning fights for his life against four Celestial Immortals, only to find a personal tragedy waiting for him. The revenge arc begins its march.
twitter_description: Four-on-one Immortal siege? Check. Timely rescue? Check. The soul-shattering grief of a junior brother? The price of patience has been tallied. Desolate Era Ch 440.

lore_anchors.definition: The supreme body-refining divine ability below the True God level. It grants the user incredible durability and the ability to split and reform their body, making them extremely difficult to kill.
The combined manifestation of the Five Element Sword Art’s ‘Lesser Five Elements Annihilation’. The five mountain phantoms represent the crushing weight and extinction of the five elements.
